title: Myth
wikitext:
Started QW in 2002 shortly after [[Cyan]] made the transfer. Cyan and Myth were notoriously known for their 2on2 teamplay. The duo also have a tendency to perform unusual but comedic ways of trolling towards their competitors. 
They were often called The Double Dragons.
